basis.body_bytes: Everything after the closing frontmatter delimiter, including its following newline and whitespace.
basis.conditional_no_extra_files: Several conditional routes have the same files as ordinary routes because current branch instructions are inline; no background/unlinked resource was made mandatory.
basis.description_characters: Whitespace-normalized description scalar only (plain, > and >- source forms); other frontmatter fields excluded.
basis.read_graph: package_reference edges enumerate owned references without claiming mandatory reads. literal_link edges record resolvable Markdown destinations and inline-code paths among inventory files; these are possible read links, not automatic runtime traversal.
basis.rendered_catalog: Unobservable from repo-only source measurement: host wrapping, visible/truncated/omitted entries and session telemetry unknown.
basis.repository_instruction_reads: Every route includes AGENTS.md plus docs/project-map.md and docs/development.md, which its development-routing section tells repository agents to read. Task-specific contract/index data and project authorities remain scenario inputs outside this source-instruction estimate.
basis.route_boundary: Source skill instruction closure only: entry files, applicable references/templates, invoked sibling skill entries and references, package module docs, AGENTS.md. Task-specific project authorities, briefs, verification, preflight, runtime code, model output and execution traces are excluded. Routes are explicit scenarios, not an exhaustive Cartesian product.
basis.route_cost: Static unique-file estimate, file_bytes; entry cost is separately available in skills. Repeated reads, command output and session use are unobserved.
basis.units: UTF-8 bytes and normalized description characters; no tokenizer used and no token estimate
basis.working_tree: HEAD 2007ca53ef92e94b76719f70ebe6e87c6baa9b6b plus user-owned AGENTS.md instruction update. Source skills are unchanged from recording HEAD.
